Product Details: The GROZ 1/2" Drive Cordless Impact Wrench is engineered for high-performance fastening across automotive, maintenance, construction and industrial applications. Powered by a high-efficiency brushless motor, it delivers consistent torque, reduced maintenance and extended tool life. Three speed modes provide precise control for a wide range of fastening tasks, while the Reverse Auto Brake automatically stops tool rotation after the fastener is loosened for enhanced safety and operational control. The intelligent Battery Management System with 12 protection modes ensures reliable performance and extended battery life. The durable 1/2" square drive with hog ring anvil enables quick socket changes for maximum productivity. Each kit includes the bare tool, battery, battery charger, carrying box, warranty card and user manual.
